body: Cycled through a proper downpour last week, stayed completely dry underneath. Hood cinches down well even in wind gusts. Zipper feels a bit cheap though, snags if you rush it.

Slate Teal is a nice muted shade, not as bright as it looks online but I like it more this way. I'm usually a M but ordered L for room to layer a fleece underneath and glad I did, chest was snug in the sample size I tried at a store. Seam taping looks well done inside, no obvious weak points.
Solid rain shell, true to size.

Does what it says on the box - rain beads right off and I haven't had any leaks after a few weeks of use. But this is a shell only, basically no insulation, so under about 8C you need something thick underneath or you'll be cold despite staying dry. Wish that was clearer in the listing.

Wasn't expecting much given the price point but this holds up well against actual weather, not just drizzle. Wore it hiking a wet trail and the hood has a stiff brim that actually keeps rain off your face instead of just flopping around. Slate Teal color matched the product photos closely.
Just need something for dog walks and errands in bad weather, works great for that. Sleeves run a touch long in the M but I push them up.
Perfect running shell, moves with me 🙂

Started noticing damp patches on the shoulders after about three weeks of regular use, right where the seam lines are. For something marketed as a technical waterproof shell that's a real problem, not just a minor gripe. Contacted support and I'm mid-return process now, can't recommend based on what I got.

Great jacket overall, XL gives plenty of room over a hoodie without feeling like a tent. Only downside is the color leans a bit darker teal than the site photo suggested, more of a deep slate blue in daylight. Not a dealbreaker, just noting it for anyone particular about exact shade.

Third piece I've bought from this store now and they keep the sizing consistent across completely different categories, which I genuinely appreciate after getting burned by inconsistent brands elsewhere. This jacket packs down small enough to stuff in the side pocket of a daypack, which matters a lot when I'm not sure if I'll need it that day. Seams are taped properly on the inside as far as I can tell without cutting it open, and the zipper pulls have decent grip even when my hands are wet, unlike a cheaper shell I owned a few years back that became nearly impossible to operate in real rain. Only tiny thing worth mentioning is the packaging was just a plain poly bag, nothing fancy, but the jacket itself arrived without a single mark on it so I really can't complain. Will keep coming back to this store for outerwear.

Ordered my normal M and it's genuinely swimming on me, more like a L or even XL by the actual measurements. Fabric quality itself is fine, waterproofing seems to work, but I can't wear this in wind without the whole thing billowing out. Returning to try a size down.

Ordered on a Monday, had it by Thursday, no complaints on delivery. Rain protection is legit, wore it through a storm at a festival and stayed dry the whole time. Slate Teal is a nice color that doesn't scream outdoor gear.

I like the design a lot and the hood is very functional, it protect well from rain on my face even when wind is strong, this was big worry for me before buying. But material is thiner than I expect from a technical jacket description, feels more like light shell than heavy duty one, so maybe not correct for very cold country like where I live. Still it works okay for normal rain days here, just not for real winter storm. Size S was correct for my body, no problem with shoulders or sleeves length, which is different experience than other online stores where I always need to guess wrong size first before getting right one. Color Slate Teal also nice in person, not too flashy for daily use at office. I think is fair jacket for medium climate, just manage expectation about warmth before you buy.

not gonna lie i was skeptical for the price but ive worn this like every rainy week since march and its holding up fine. hood stays up in wind which is honestly rare, ive had way pricier jackets fail at that. shoulders were a little tight at first in the M but loosened up after a few wears, no big deal now
customerProfile: student on a budget, skeptical then convinced
